title: Threshold count for list keys
statement: Let $kd:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, let $\pi$ be a finite list of natural numbers, and let $s\in\mathbb{N}$. The number of positions in the list whose key under $kd$ is less than $s$ equals the number of list entries $i$ for which $kd(i)<s$.
hypotheses_covered: $kd$ is a function from natural numbers to natural numbers.
$\pi$ is a finite list of natural numbers.
